item.title: What Institutional On-Chain Lending Has Been Missing: Privacy with Isolation
item.description: Privacy isn't a feature Canton added to a lending market. It's the thesis the network was built on. Why institutional on-chain credit needs selective disclosure, market-level isolation and atomic settlement from the same infrastructure.
